tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because it is pure Rust and avoids the complexity of C bindings.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is rustls as the TLS backend, because it is pure Rust and avoids the complexity of C bindings.

An earlier decision to use OpenSSL (#14) is also on record. The later rustls decision (#16) came after it, and a Muninn episode record (#15) shows the switch away from OpenSSL. So I treated OpenSSL as retired and left it out of the file. Muninn did not mark #16 as explicitly replacing #14, so that call rests on the order of the records and the episode.
